stories.headline: [CNN] Hegseth and Kid Rock went ‘for a ride’ with Army helicopter pilots weeks after previous Apache incident sparked criticism Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said that he and Kid Rock went “for a ride” Monday with US Army Apache helicopter pilots — less than a month after the military s
stories.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and musician Kid Rock went for a ride with US Army Apache helicopter pilots on Monday. This incident occurred less than a month after the military faced criticism for flying Apaches over Kid Rock's Nashville-area home. The previous flyby sparked controversy, and now Hegseth and Kid Rock have taken to the skies in Army Apache attack helicopters. Typically, Apaches have two pilots, but in this case, they flew with one pilot so that Hegseth and Kid Rock could each ride in the front seat. The ride took place near Washington, with the exact location not specified. The incident has raised questions about the use of military resources for personal activities. The Army had previously come under scrutiny for the flyby at Kid Rock's home, which was seen as an inappropriate use of military assets.

stories.headline: [The New York Times] The Art of the Nuclear Deal President Trump ripped up a pact designed to prevent Iran from building a bomb. Getting a better agreement now could prove difficult.
stories.summary: The United States withdrew from the Iran nuclear deal, known as the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action (JCPOA), on May 8, 2018. The agreement, reached in 2015 by Iran, the US, and other world powers, aimed to prevent Iran from building a nuclear bomb. The deal was set to expire over 10 to 25 years, but President Trump's withdrawal has made achieving a new agreement challenging. The JCPOA followed two years of negotiations and was considered a landmark achievement. At the time of US compliance, the deal had extended Iran's nuclear "breakout" time to about one year, significantly reducing the risk of Iran producing a nuclear bomb. The withdrawal has led to difficulties in negotiating a better agreement, with both Trump and Biden administrations attempting but failing to secure a new deal.

stories.headline: [The Age] Cole Tomas Allen in court; King Charles, Queen Camilla in Washington; Iran proposal on Strait of Hormuz reopening discussed by White House Follow our live coverage of the conflict in the Middle East, King Charles and Queen Camilla’s US state visit and related developments in Australia.
stories.summary: Cole Tomas Allen, a 31-year-old teacher and video game developer from California, appeared in court after being accused of rushing a security checkpoint at the White House Correspondents' Dinner. He allegedly exchanged gunfire with law enforcement while armed with a shotgun, handgun, and knives. Allen's social media profiles show his background as a teacher and game developer. The incident occurred on April 25, 2026, in Washington, D.C. Meanwhile, King Charles and Queen Camilla are in Washington for a US state visit, and the White House is discussing a proposal from Iran regarding the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. The situation in the Middle East and related developments in Australia are also being closely monitored. Investigators are piecing together details about the suspect and the shooting incident.

stories.headline: [Pakistan Today] Efforts under way for release of Pakistani crew Sindh governor says authorities are working for the safe release of 11 Pakistani crew members held after an oil tanker hijacking near Somalia.
stories.summary: Sindh Governor Syed Muhammad Nihal Hashmi has assured that the government is working to secure the safe release of 11 Pakistani crew members held hostage by Somali pirates. The crew was taken hostage after pirates seized the oil tanker, Owner 25, in the Gulf of Aden near the Bab-el-Mandeb Strait off Somalia's coast last Tuesday. Hashmi met with the affected families and stated that the government is taking "all-out measures" to ensure their safe release. Authorities have been directed to pursue efforts for the release of the hostages. The governor emphasized that the government has not abandoned the crew members and is actively working towards their safe return. Efforts are underway to negotiate their release, with the government committed to bringing the Pakistani nationals home safely.

stories.headline: COLORFUL Introduces New BATTLE-AX B860M and B760M Motherboards with Wi-Fi 7 and Next-Gen CPU Support
stories.summary: COLORFUL has introduced two new motherboards, the BATTLE-AX B860M-PLUS S WIFI7 and B760M-PLUS S WIFI7, featuring Wi-Fi 7 and support for next-generation CPUs. The B860M-PLUS S WIFI7 supports DDR5 performance, while the B760M-PLUS S WIFI7 offers cost-effective DDR4 compatibility. Both models support Intel 12th, 13th, and 4th gen Core series, as well as Core Ultra 200S Series, with LGA1700 CPU support and PCIe 5.0 graphics connectivity. The motherboards also come with Bluetooth 5.4, 5G LAN, and a power delivery system of 10+1+1+1 phases with 60A DrMOS. These new models provide users with a choice between high-performance DDR5 and cost-effective DDR4 upgrades, both with the latest Wi-Fi 7 technology.

stories.headline: Here's your first look at Gemini's new 'Proactive Assistance' feature
stories.summary: Google's Gemini AI assistant is developing a new "Proactive Assistance" feature, which delivers timely and context-aware suggestions based on user activity. The feature, found in the latest Google app beta on Android, can anticipate user needs and provide suggestions automatically without direct commands. According to decompiled code, users can choose apps like Gmail and Calendar for Proactive Assistance to use for suggestions. The feature can also access what's on the user's screen and their notifications. This allows Proactive Assistance to handle tasks before being asked, making Gemini a smarter AI assistant. The feature is currently hidden in the beta version, but its discovery hints at a future update that will enhance Gemini's capabilities. The setup flow for Proactive Assistance is described in the decompiled code, indicating a forthcoming release.

stories.headline: Samsung Galaxy S26+ review: The ‘Plus Buy’ that holds its ground
stories.summary: The Samsung Galaxy S26+ offers a mix of hardware and software features, including the latest chipset and AI-led capabilities, prioritizing everyday performance, display, and battery. The device boasts a large, sharp 6.7-inch OLED display, making it appealing to Samsung fans who want a high-quality screen without the high cost of the Ultra model. While the camera is strong overall, those seeking the best photo quality may prefer the Galaxy S26 Ultra or competing phones like the Oppo Find X9 Pro or Vivo X300 Pro. The S26+ provides a practical flagship experience, with a bright and crisp screen, vibrant colors, and smooth performance, making it a suitable choice for many, especially those who value a large display and fast performance without breaking the bank. The phone's position in the lineup is justified by its balance of features and price.

stories.headline: BIR Digital TIN ID now available in the eGovPH app
stories.summary: The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) has made digital Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) IDs available through the eGovPH app. To access the digital TIN ID, users must download the eGovPH app from the Google Play Store or Apple App Store and create an account with accurate personal details. The digital TIN ID will be available if the user's eGovPH profile matches their BIR records. Users can view their digital TIN ID in the "Digital ID" section of the app. The feature was launched on April 24, 2026, and is part of the BIR's Online Registration and Update System (ORUS). The digital TIN ID can be accessed through the app's Mobile ID Wallet, providing Filipino taxpayers with a convenient and digital way to secure their credentials. The BIR requires a match between the user's eGovPH profile and BIR records to access the digital ID.

stories.headline: Terry Rozier could face new federal bribery charges in alleged gambling scheme
stories.summary: Terry Rozier, an NBA guard, is facing potential new federal bribery charges related to an alleged sports gambling scheme. Prosecutors claim to have evidence that Rozier solicited and accepted a bribe, and will present these charges to a grand jury. The allegations include sports bribery and honest services fraud. Rozier's involvement in the scheme was previously reported, and prosecutors now intend to file superseding charges against him. The case is ongoing, with federal prosecutors overseeing the investigation into the sports gambling ring. Rozier's alleged actions are said to have occurred during his involvement with the ring, and the new charges could lead to further legal consequences for the basketball player. Prosecutors are preparing to present their evidence to a grand jury, which will determine whether to indict Rozier on the new charges.

stories.headline: Manchester United close in on Champions League qualification, Carrick says work still pending
stories.summary: Manchester United has taken a significant step towards qualifying for the Champions League with a 2-1 win over Brentford. The victory puts them on the brink of returning to the tournament after a two-season absence. Interim manager Michael Carrick cautioned against over-celebration, emphasizing the need to finish as high up the Premier League table as possible. United's recent form has been impressive, with eight wins in their last 12 Premier League games under Carrick. They face a crucial test against Liverpool on May 3, as they continue to push for Champions League qualification and a strong table finish. Carrick's side is focused on securing their position and will look to maintain their momentum in the remaining games. With this win, Manchester United is close to achieving their goal, but Carrick remains focused on the work still to be done.

stories.headline: 'I hate all Indian bowlers': Pakistan batter Hasan Nawaz's bitter remark leads to stinging criticism
stories.summary: Pakistan batsman Hasan Nawaz has sparked controversy with his statement that he hates all Indian bowlers. In a recent interview with a local news channel, the 23-year-old expressed that matches against India bring him extra motivation. He stated that he wants to score against every Indian bowler because of his dislike for them. Nawaz's comments have gone viral on social media, with fans criticizing his hateful remark. The statement has garnered significant attention, particularly given the intense rivalry between the Indian and Pakistani cricket teams. Nawaz's words mark a departure from the usual diplomatic tone used by cricketers, and he has faced stinging criticism for his comments. The video of his interview has been widely shared, with many calling out the hatred in his statement.

stories.headline: Suns Offseason Preview: Free Agency, Draft Assets And the Dillon Brooks Question
stories.summary: The Phoenix Suns are facing a complex 2026 offseason after being swept by the Thunder in the first round. A key decision revolves around the future of forward Dillon Brooks, who had a career year as a centerpiece of the playoff roster. The team lacks draft assets, adding to the complexity of their offseason. Despite a late collapse last season, the Suns' retooled roster showed improvement this year. However, significant changes are expected across the franchise. The team will need to make key decisions on free agency and navigate their limited draft assets to build a competitive roster for the upcoming season. Devin Booker is expected to lead the revamped team, with the goal of returning to the playoffs. The Suns' offseason moves will be crucial in determining their success in the 2026-2027 season.

stories.headline: Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation Election Result 2026 LIVE: Counting begins; BJP wins two seats unopposed
stories.summary: Counting of votes for the 192 seats in the Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation election has begun. The BJP has won two seats unopposed, namely Vasna and Thaltej. As of the latest update, the BJP is leading, having won 160 seats, while the Congress has won 32 seats. The Aam Aadmi Party and others have won zero seats. A total of 652 candidates contested the election across 48 wards. The winners of the unopposed seats include Payalben Patel, Hina Patel, Vishnubhai Prajapati, and Ketankumar Patel, all from the BJP. The counting is ongoing, with the BJP panel currently in the lead. The election results are being updated by the Gujarat State Election Commission.

stories.headline: Gujarat Local Body Election Result 2026 LIVE: BJP opens account in Vapi Municipal Corporation, Counting underway
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has secured a massive win in the Gujarat local body elections 2026, bagging all 15 municipal corporations. The party has crossed the 50 per cent-mark in each corporation. In the Vapi Municipal Corporation, the BJP has won after the results for all 52 seats across 13 wards were announced. The party had already won 736 seats unopposed, sparking allegations from the Opposition of pressuring candidates and influencing withdrawals. The election results cover over nine thousand seats across municipal and panchayat bodies, with vote counting taking place on April 28. The BJP's sweep is the biggest-ever in Gujarat local body elections, with the party winning all 15 municipal corporations. The results indicate a significant victory for the BJP in the state's local body elections.

stories.headline: Nashik hospital staff injured after head trapped in lift, accident caught on CCTV
stories.summary: A contract worker at Dr Vasantrao Pawar Medical College, Hospital and Research Centre in Nashik, India, died after her head got trapped in an equipment lift. The incident occurred on Monday at around 9am, with CCTV footage showing the lift suddenly moving and trapping her head, causing critical injuries. Another staff member noticed the accident and alerted others, who gathered to rescue her but were unable to free her immediately. The victim remained trapped for several minutes before being rescued and was taken to the ICU. She later succumbed to her injuries. Police have filed a negligence case against the hospital after receiving a complaint, and an investigation into the incident is ongoing. The victim's death has sparked an inquiry into the safety measures and equipment maintenance at the hospital.

stories.headline: PM Modi joins youngsters for friendly football game in Gangtok during Sikkim visit; shares pictures
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi played a friendly football game with youngsters in Gangtok, Sikkim, during his two-day visit to the state. Dressed in a blue sports jacket featuring the tricolour, Modi was seen walking and playing with the young players. He shared pictures of the session on social media, captioning it "Clearly, an energising football session with these youngsters!" and "Nothing like playing some football with my young friends in Sikkim on a lovely Gangtok morning!" Tight security arrangements were in place across the state capital and nearby areas for the visit. Modi's football session with the youngsters was a highlight of his trip, showcasing a lighter moment during his official visit to Sikkim. The prime minister's social media posts featured photographs of him playing soccer with boys and girls in Gangtok.

stories.headline: Markets are reasonable but not cheap: Kalpen Parekh of DSP Mutual Fund flags risks from geopolitics, flows, and inflation; urges disciplined investing
stories.summary: Kalpen Parekh, MD & CEO of DSP Mutual Fund, states that the market is reasonable but not cheap. He flags risks from geopolitics, flows, and inflation, and advises disciplined investing. Despite the market consolidating over the past year, Parekh believes it remains expensive, and investors should moderate their return expectations. He notes that the euphoria of recent years has faded, and returns have normalized. Parekh suggests a contrarian approach, favoring the BFSI sector. He emphasizes the importance of disciplined investing, citing India's macro resilience and stretched valuations. Parekh's comments are aimed at investors, urging them to be cautious and manage their expectations in the current market environment. His advice is relevant to worried investors seeking guidance on navigating the market's challenges and opportunities.

stories.headline: Bitcoin Magazine announced BM TV, its forthcoming daily broadcast focused on Bitcoin markets, macroeconomics, geopolitics, and frontier technology.
stories.summary: Bitcoin Magazine is launching BM TV, a daily live broadcast network focused on Bitcoin markets, macroeconomics, geopolitics, and frontier technology. The network will debut in Summer 2026 from Nashville and air across six platforms, reaching a projected 58 million annual impressions. BM TV will provide live weekday coverage of relevant topics, analyzing millions of data points to measure engagement and calculate the Panic Score, which highlights market-moving news. The network will be available on multiple platforms, offering a comprehensive source of information on Bitcoin and related topics. Bitcoin Magazine's existing news feed, Bitcoin News, is a 24/7 crypto news source covering the world economy, exchange rates, and money politics, making BM TV a significant expansion of the company's media offerings. The launch aims to provide in-depth coverage and analysis of the Bitcoin market and its related fields.

stories.headline: No other headlines are provided to select from, only two are given.
stories.summary: APNews.com provides independent journalism from around the globe, offering the latest headlines, breaking news, and videos. Google News and Yahoo News also provide updates on global news and stories, with breaking news, in-depth coverage, videos, and photos. NPR offers news, audio, and podcasts, covering national and world news, politics, business, science, and technology. CBS News provides breaking news coverage of top headlines, with balanced and trustworthy reporting. These news sources offer comprehensive coverage of major national and world events, keeping readers informed on current events. With a range of topics and formats, including videos, photos, and podcasts, these sources cater to diverse interests and preferences, making it easy to stay updated on the latest news and developments from around the world.

stories.headline: Oil Price Surge, FII Outflows Drag Indian Stock Markets Lower Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty experienced declines due to a sharp rally in crude oil prices, continuous foreign fund outflows, and geopolitical uncertainty
stories.summary: Indian benchmark indices, Sensex and Nifty, declined due to a sharp rally in crude oil prices and persistent foreign fund outflows. The 30-share BSE Sensex declined 416.72 points, or 0.54%, to settle at 76,886.91. The decline was also attributed to weakness in IT stocks and a negative trend in global markets. Geopolitical uncertainty added to the selling pressure. Foreign fund outflows continued to dent investors' sentiment, contributing to the market downturn. The surge in oil prices and unabated foreign fund outflows led to a decline in investor sentiment, resulting in the Sensex and Nifty tumbling in early trade. The market opened lower, with the Sensex declining 208.84 points to 77,094.79 in opening trade, as investors remained cautious due to the prevailing market conditions.

stories.headline: Sensex slips 100 pts, Nifty below 24,100 as fading peace hopes and surging oil prices spook investors Indian stock markets, Sensex and Nifty, saw a dip on Tuesday. This followed a strong performance the previous day. Investor sentiment was affected by concerns over
stories.summary: Indian stock markets, Sensex and Nifty, dipped on Tuesday after a strong performance the previous day. The Sensex slipped 100 points, while the Nifty fell below 24,100. Investor sentiment was affected by concerns over the Iran-US conflict and surging oil prices. Brent crude surged above $100 per barrel, with the April futures contract trading 2.07% higher at $107.25 per barrel. This sharp rise in global crude oil prices dampened investor sentiment, leading to a decline in the markets. The Sensex dropped 250 points, and the Nifty slipped below 24,100, with the GIFT Nifty trading flat, indicating a muted start for Indian indices. The surge in oil prices and massive selling in IT stocks contributed to the market decline, forcing the Sensex off its weekly highs.

stories.headline: Stock Market Updates: Sensex Falls 200 Points, Nifty Tests 24,000; PSU Bank, Financial Stocks Drag The Nifty50 and the Sensex fall as traders assessed the latest development in the US-Iran relationship.
stories.summary: The Nifty50 and Sensex have fallen, with the Nifty testing 24,000, due to concerns over the US-Iran relationship. The decline is attributed to a rise in oil prices caused by halted supply from the Strait of Hormuz. PSU bank and financial stocks are dragging the market down. The Sensex has slipped over 200 points, while the Nifty50 has declined 0.13%. The ongoing tensions between the US and Iran have spooked investors, leading to a drop in the market. The impasse in the US-Iran talks has also contributed to the decline. Metal stocks have gained amid the uncertainty. The market has been volatile, with the Sensex and Nifty dropping up to 0.5% in recent sessions, as investors remain cautious due to the geopolitical tensions. The market opened in red, with the Nifty50 below 24,150 and the BSE Sensex down over 100 points.

stories.headline: Stock Market Live Updates: Sensex, Nifty rally may face resistance as oil prices rise; what’s the outlook? Stock Market Live Updates: GIFT Nifty indicates a subdued start for stock markets on Tuesday. Analysts are of the view that the near term trend would
stories.summary: The Indian stock market is expected to face resistance due to rising oil prices, with the Nifty potentially encountering resistance in the 24,115-24,150 zone. Analysts predict a volatile near-term trend, influenced by geopolitical events surrounding the US-Iran situation. The Sensex and Nifty had previously closed at 76,681.29 and 23,897.95, respectively, with a decline of 1.27% and 1.14%. Technical indicators show strong momentum, but also suggest potential for near-term profit booking. The market had rebounded on broad-based buying led by pharma, IT, auto, and metals sectors. However, analysts signal a range-bound trend with stock-specific opportunities amid global uncertainty, with the GIFT Nifty indicating a subdued start for stock markets on Tuesday. Volatility is expected to persist due to the ongoing deadlock in US-Iran talks and naval blockades.

stories.headline: SBI, Canara Bank, BoB: PSU bank shares fall over 3% post-ECL norms update; all you need to know
stories.summary: Shares of state-run banks in India fell over 3% on Tuesday after the Reserve Bank of India confirmed the rollout of the Expected Credit Loss (ECL) framework from April 2027. The ECL provisioning framework mandates a forward-looking approach, replacing the "incurred loss" model. This change is expected to lead to higher provisioning and a potential 5-10% hit to net worth, triggering concerns among investors. The NIFTY PSU Bank index traded 1.3% lower at 8,738.65 levels, with all 12 constituents in the red. Stocks of major public sector banks, including SBI, Canara Bank, Bank of Baroda, and PNB, declined due to the potential increase in credit costs. However, the phased implementation of the ECL framework may soften the immediate impact on banks. The update has led to a sell-off in PSU bank stocks, despite their recent gains.

stories.headline: Tanker markets tip into oversupply with ballast surge
stories.summary: Tanker markets have shifted into oversupply due to a surge in ballast, pushing crude tanker classes back into an owner-competition market. With over half of the fleet in key classes currently open and repositioning, rate support is weakening rapidly. Unless cargo demand accelerates, the market is expected to remain challenging. The ballast build is driven by the need to exchange at least 95% of ballast water, as required by the BWM convention regulation D1, which can be achieved through deballasting and re-filling or other methods. This development has significant operational implications for tanker owners and operators, who must adapt to changing market conditions to remain competitive. The surge in ballast is a key factor in the current market dynamics, and its impact is being closely monitored by industry stakeholders.

stories.headline: Uniting Global Stakeholders to Advance Green Supply Chain Transformation at Shanghai Climate Week
stories.summary: The Green Supply Chain Transformation Forum was held at the Baowu Carbon Neutrality Industrial Park in Shanghai as part of Shanghai Climate Week 2026. The event, themed "Carbon Co-explore, Chain the Future Shore", aimed to unite global stakeholders in advancing green supply chain transformation. China's supply chain plays a crucial role in achieving global energy transition targets, with its absence making it virtually impossible to meet cost and scale objectives. The forum coincided with Earth Day, highlighting China's dual-carbon commitments. Experts stressed the importance of structured planning for long-term resilience, warning that unmanaged transitions risk economic instability and energy insecurity. The event sought to drive awareness of the severity of the global climate situation and promote a transformed supply chain to enable effective international competition. Shanghai Climate Week links local initiatives to global climate negotiations.

stories.headline: Vendors commend GAWU for creating market access at trade fair
stories.summary: Vendors who participated in a trade fair organised by the General Agricultural Workers' Union (GAWU) in Accra have commended the union for creating a platform to showcase their products and connect them to potential customers. The fair provided market access to the vendors, allowing them to display their goods and interact with potential buyers. GAWU has been advocating for the establishment of a Ghana Agricultural Services Authority to strengthen the agricultural sector. The union has also urged the government to address pressing issues impacting food production. The trade fair is part of GAWU's efforts to support the trading community and strengthen its presence in the region. The event has been hailed as a success, with vendors praising GAWU for providing them with a valuable opportunity to promote their products.

stories.headline: [SFGATE] Tuesday Morning News Roundup Monday marked the first official day of the trial of Elon Musk's lawsuit against Sam Altman and the artificial intelligence developer OpenAI, the company respon
stories.summary: Elon Musk's lawsuit against Sam Altman and OpenAI has begun trial in California. The case revolves around allegations that OpenAI abandoned its nonprofit roots in favor of profit. Musk claims the company betrayed its original vision for artificial intelligence development. OpenAI's CEO, Sam Altman, has been at the helm since 2019. The trial will see Musk's lawyers argue that OpenAI prioritized profit over its initial nonprofit mission, with Microsoft also named in the suit. Musk's own AI company, xAI, now part of SpaceX, trails behind OpenAI in usage. The trial is a high-stakes showdown between the two tech moguls, with SpaceX planning to go public this year in a potentially record-breaking IPO. The jury will hear opening arguments and decide on the allegations of deceit and betrayal.

stories.headline: [Firstpost] More than 600 Google workers write to Sundar Pichai to refuse Pentagon deal for classified AI work Hundreds of Google employees have urged CEO Sundar Pichai to reject Pentagon deals involving classified AI work, citing transparency and ethical concerns.
stories.summary: More than 600 Google employees have written to CEO Sundar Pichai, urging him to reject a Pentagon deal involving classified AI work. The employees' concern centers on transparency, as classified work would prevent the company from knowing how its technology is deployed, removing oversight. Google is in talks with the Pentagon to use its AI system, Gemini, in classified settings. The employees argue that this would raise ethical concerns over the military use of AI for weapons. They are calling on Pichai to block the classified Pentagon AI deals, citing the need for transparency and oversight in the use of Google's technology. The letter highlights the employees' concerns about the potential consequences of Google's AI being used in secret military projects.

stories.headline: [VentureBeat] Microsoft and OpenAI gut their exclusive deal, freeing OpenAI to sell on AWS and Google Cloud Microsoft and OpenAI have dismantled their exclusive partnership, ending revenue sharing and freeing OpenAI to sell its AI models on AWS and Google Cloud in a s
stories.summary: Microsoft and OpenAI have ended their exclusive partnership, allowing OpenAI to sell its AI models on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud. The revised agreement dismantles revenue sharing and exclusivity, enabling OpenAI to expand its distribution across multiple clouds. Microsoft retains a non-exclusive license to OpenAI's intellectual property for models and products until 2032. This change allows OpenAI to broaden its enterprise distribution and potentially partner with other cloud providers. The updated deal opens OpenAI's technology to rival cloud platforms, marking a significant shift in the companies' relationship. OpenAI is now free to sell its AI models on various cloud platforms, increasing its reach and accessibility to a wider range of customers. The move is expected to drive expansion and growth for OpenAI.

stories.headline: [The Economic Times] Opening remarks Tuesday in Elon Musk versus OpenAI trial A courtroom showdown begins Tuesday between billionaire Elon Musk and OpenAI. Musk alleges the artificial intelligence company betrayed its non-profit mission.
stories.summary: A courtroom trial between Elon Musk and OpenAI began with opening remarks on Tuesday. Musk alleges that OpenAI betrayed its non-profit mission, sparking a legal clash between the billionaire and the artificial intelligence company he once backed. The trial, held at a federal courthouse in Oakland, California, started with jury selection followed by opening arguments. Musk's team addressed the jury, marking the beginning of a case that could have far-reaching consequences for the future of artificial intelligence. OpenAI is led by Sam Altman, and the trial may hinge on evidence such as a personal diary belonging to an executive. The case pits Musk, the world's richest person, against a startup he once supported, now a competitor in the booming AI sector.
